svg.title: A constrained service remains live
svg.desc: Combine a live service, clean contents and reduced access in one view. Keep moss absent; constrained operation must not look like either total shutdown or an unchanged vulnerable system. Visual distinction: A sieve with one narrow allowed aperture and stopped alternative lanes. Shows a reduced request surface without claiming all access is blocked. Pin the folder to its empty after rebuild state; the object silhouette persists while its status changes.
